description: Defines the class 'pdu_session_resource_setup_routine' which manages the setup of PDU session resources in a 5G network core component, involving procedures with CU-UP and DU, and handling various signaling and context modifications.

classes.name: pdu_session_resource_setup_routine
classes.description: Handles the setup of PDU session resources, coordinating multiple procedures involving CU-UP and DU, and managing signaling and context modifications.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Executes the routine asynchronously, processing the setup request and generating a response.

methods.name: fill_e1ap_bearer_context_setup_request
methods.description: Prepares the E1AP bearer context setup request message.

methods.name: fill_initial_e1ap_bearer_context_modification_request
methods.description: Prepares the initial E1AP bearer context modification request message.

methods.name: handle_pdu_session_resource_setup_result
methods.description: Handles the result of the PDU session resource setup, returning the response message.
